question: Which company built the spacecraft Michael Collins stayed in while the first Moon landing took place?
answer: Michael Collins stayed in lunar orbit aboard the command module Columbia during the landing [[michael-collins]] "[stated] Stayed in lunar orbit aboard the command module Columbia during the landing (src: NASA Apollo 11 mission page, 2026-10-24)". question: For about how long were the heaters of the tank that later exploded on Apollo 13 run on ground power before launch, and what did the investigating board say started the explosion?
answer:
The heaters of Oxygen tank No. 2 ran on 65-volt ground power for about eight hours before launch. [[oxygen-tank-2]] "[stated] Before launch it was emptied by running its heaters on 65-volt ground power for about eight hours (src: Moonport SP-4204, 2026-10-24)"

The Apollo 13 Review Board traced the explosion to an electrically started fire in that tank. [[apollo-13-review-board]] "[stated] Traced the explosion to an electrically started fire in oxygen tank No. 2 (src: Apollo 13 Review Board report, 2026-10-24)"

The board's switch findings are in the report, which called the switch failure a serious oversight shared by all parties. [[apollo-13-review-board-report]] "[stated] Called the switch failure a serious oversight in which all parties share (src: Michigan Daily 1970 coverage, 2026-10-24)"

question: How long before Kennedy's speech at Rice University did NASA announce its Apollo mission mode?
